name: Ogmia

attributes.attribute: British counterpart of Ogmios and Ogma
drawn with curly hair and head-rays

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ogmia is a British god. He was the British counterpart of the continental god of eloquence, Ogmios, and of the Irish god Ogma. Roman-Celtic artists showed him as a youth with curly hair and rays rising from his head. Of his myth and cult nothing is known.

key_results: Artists represented him with curly hair and rays from his head.
He was the British form of Ogmios and Ogma.
No myth or cult of his is recorded.
